content: msgspec 0.21.1 verified empirically (local, 2026-08-18) against stdlib frozen+slots dataclasses via msgspec.convert: extra/unknown keys are SILENTLY IGNORED by default (no signal at all); missing required field -> ValidationError 'Object missing required field `x`' with a path only when nested ('- at `$.rows[1]`'), none at root; wrong type -> 'Expected `float`, got `str` - at `$.ultimoPrecio`'; null -> 'Expected `float`, got `null`'; Literal field with an unknown server value -> 'Invalid enum value ...' i.e. response-side Literals HARD FAIL on enum growth. strict=False enables lax coercion ('1.5'->1.5). Only the FIRST error is reported -- there is no collect-all-errors mode (see issue #425). Error messages never include the offending value, only its type (credential-safe by construction).
